games.blurb: A top-25 opener with real weight: No. 23 Clemson heads to Death Valley as a 10.5-point underdog to No. 13 LSU. The 50.5 total says oddsmakers expect defense and field position to decide it.
The Apple Cup returns with No. 19 Washington favored by 21.5 at home. Washington State gets the rivalry emotion, but the number suggests little else.
Louisville draws the toughest Week 1 road trip of the group at No. 10 Ole Miss, where the Rebels are only 6.5-point favorites. A 55.5 total hints this one could get loose in a hurry.
Wisconsin visits No. 5 Notre Dame as a 20.5-point underdog with the total set at just 47.5. The market isn't giving the Badgers much room to hang around.
The Border War kicks off the weekend with Colorado State favored by just four at home. Unranked, but the closest line on the board.
No. 16 Michigan opens at home as a 26.5-point favorite over Western Michigan. Tune-up football, with the Wolverines' new-look season starting on cruise control.

predictions.blurb: Texas checks in at No. 4 in the poll, and FPI is even higher on the Longhorns at No. 2 -- one of the few teams the metrics like more than the voters.
Texas Tech sits 12th in the rankings with FPI slotting the Red Raiders at No. 10, a rare case of Big 12 hype and the numbers lining up.
Michigan lands at No. 16 with FPI a tick higher at No. 15 -- essentially a consensus on the Wolverines entering the year.
BYU is the poll's No. 15 team but only 20th by FPI, making the Cougars one of the more likely candidates for early-season regression.
LSU opens 13th in the poll while FPI has the Tigers ninth, a sign the metrics see more in Baton Rouge than the voters do.
